name: Scamper
summary: A bold sign-in page whose Sign in button has feet and runs from your mouse until the form is ready
about: A neo-brutalist sign-in page where the Sign in button is a little character with eyes, hands and feet. While the email or password is missing it dashes away from the pointer with dust puffs and teasing speech bubbles, then walks home happily once both fields are valid. It is a fun login screen for games, kids apps and playful brands, and it still works fully with the keyboard and on touch screens.
how: The page pops in with stickers, and the button says hi from its play zone
Move the mouse near the button while a field is empty: it squashes, dashes off and teases you
Type your email and the button's eyes follow the caret; on the password field it covers its eyes, and Show password lets it peek
When both fields are valid the strip reads 2/2 and the button walks back home to be clicked
Sign in runs a progress bar while its feet run in place, then jumps with confetti on success or keels over dizzy on a wrong password
Use Fill demo for the working details, and Sign out to reset everything
